title: Land-border crossing status
description: Source file data/borders/border_status.yaml: one entry per period in which a land border is closed or restricted to regular traffic. Absence of an entry means no closure is recorded, not that the border is verified open.

countries.description: The two iso3code values of the border, sorted.

status.description: closed: no land crossing on the border is open to regular traffic of goods. restricted: at least one crossing is closed, or traffic is limited to named categories.

since.description: Start of the period (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD); omitted when no qualifying source gives it.

until.description: End of the period when the border reopened; null or absent for the current entry.

note.description: Which crossings are closed, in neutral words.

last_verified.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the entry was last checked against its sources.

provenance.description: Government, intergovernmental or official border/customs sources.

deferred.description: Candidate pairs (AAA-BBB) not added, with the reason.
